_help: Featured items and ad slots. featured.items: part ids from parts.json (tag = short label). ads: one entry per paid ad; slot = home | parts | builds; shown only between start and end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). When a slot has no live ad, the house ad is shown instead. Set house to null to leave empty slots hidden.

featured.title: Pinili ng ReSpecz

house.title: Gusto mo bang ma-feature ang Store or Brand mo?
house.text: Nakikita ito ng mga nagpaplano ng PC build. Mag-message sa ReSpecz sa Facebook para sa ad o featured slot.
